decls.name: Job
decls.doc: Job is the queue message: a reference to the staged object, not the reading.

pkgs.name: ingestion
pkgs.doc:
Package ingestion is the HTTP entry: POST /readings. It may write the
staging bucket and publish to both topics, nothing else.

pkgs.name: query
pkgs.doc:
Package query serves GET /readings. It may only list and read the results
bucket.

pkgs.name: reading
pkgs.doc:
Package reading holds what all services share: the reading types, the JSON
schemas (copied from sensorhub/src/backend/schema) and the validation and
normalization rules from sensorhub/doc/SPEC.md. It declares no Encore
resources and no APIs, so it is a plain library package, not a service.

pkgs.name: resources
pkgs.doc:
Package resources declares every bucket and topic of the sensor hub in one
place. It has no API, so it is not a service; each service reaches the
resources it needs through a typed reference (BucketRef / TopicRef), and
Encore derives that service's access from the reference's permission type.

pkgs.name: speedparser
pkgs.doc:
Package speedparser consumes only the speed topic. It may read the staging
bucket and write the results bucket.

pkgs.name: voltageparser
pkgs.doc:
Package voltageparser consumes only the line-voltage topic. It may read the staging
bucket and write the results bucket.

pubsub_topics.name: sensorhub-speed
pubsub_topics.doc:
Topics: one per kind. Encore has no raw queue; a topic with one subscription
is the closest equivalent.

pubsub_topics.name: sensorhub-line-voltage
pubsub_topics.doc:
Topics: one per kind. Encore has no raw queue; a topic with one subscription
is the closest equivalent.

buckets.name: sensorhub-staging
buckets.doc: Buckets: raw uploads and normalized results.

buckets.name: sensorhub-results
buckets.doc: Buckets: raw uploads and normalized results.
